svg.title: Black Over White
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and standardized vivid palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-los-angeles-01-2012/lightbox/works/black-over-white-1966-2129; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.
